prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game character pose atlas for Familiar First Light.
Input image: identity and material reference ONLY. Recreate EXACT same Mochi kitten: plump orange tabby with three forehead stripes, cream muzzle/belly/paw tips, black bead eyes, small brown nose, red knitted scarf, brown leather crossbody satchel hanging on the character's RIGHT hip (viewer LEFT in front view), curled orange striped tail with cream tip. Same soft clay/felt handcrafted miniature material, same head/body proportions and warm upper-left studio light.

Primary request: one precise 4-column by 4-row sprite sheet, SIXTEEN full-body Mochi poses, ordered row-major as described below. A square 2048x2048 image divided into 16 identical 512x512 invisible cells. Each pose belongs fully inside its own cell with 10% empty transparent margins. All grounded feet share local y=448 baseline, head height and body scale consistent across cells, body pivot centered at local x=256. Keep every tail, paw and scarf fully inside its own cell. Transparent exterior, NO ground/floor/shadows, no separators, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no scenery, no props besides Mochi's own scarf and satchel. Every cell contains exactly ONE complete Mochi. Careful curious personality, restrained soft stop-motion posing, never exaggerated squash or a jumping gait.

Row 1, left to right:
0 neutral standing, three-quarter FRONT view, facing slightly right, all feet grounded, match reference.
1 head looking to screen RIGHT, torso still near front, ears attentive.
2 body turning to screen RIGHT, three-quarter right view, head leads, paws plant.
3 full right-facing PROFILE, nose pointing screen right, tail at rear, satchel remains anatomically on same hip, not mirrored.

Row 2, left to right: four consecutive grounded WALK RIGHT cycle key poses, same rightward three-quarter view, body almost same position/height, short tiny careful steps:
4 first contact: near forepaw forward/down, far forepaw back, opposite hindpaw forward.
5 first passing: near forepaw under chest/raised slightly, hind legs passing.
6 opposite contact: far forepaw forward/down, near forepaw back, opposite legs switch.
7 opposite passing: far forepaw under chest/raised slightly, near forepaw reaching next contact.
Use articulated separate paws, feet close to floor, continuous calm step cycle; NOT four copies, NOT jumping.

Row 3, left to right:
8 planted three-quarter LEFT turn, nose screen left, authentic opposite body view, preserve anatomical satchel side rather than mirroring.
9 reach anticipation toward screen LEFT: left-facing three-quarter stance, one front paw lifting, weight stays on other three paws.
10 full reach toward screen LEFT: same feet/body anchor, leading front paw extended horizontally left at chest height, curious intent face, three other paws grounded.
11 gentle pull inward/stow: same left-facing stance, leading paw tucks toward satchel/chest, slight weight back, three feet planted.

Row 4, left to right:
12 curious front pose, head cocked gently toward screen RIGHT, one ear slightly forward, all feet grounded.
13 surprised small recoil: ears a little back, wide bead eyes, front paw slightly raised, alert but safe and cute.
14 low braced recovery: four feet grounded a bit wider, knees bent, head a little low, eyes attentive; no injury.
15 relieved pleased front-three-quarter pose: eyes softly closed in a smile, shoulders relaxed, paws grounded.

Constraints: same character model and camera elevation in every cell, identity-lock face/scarf/satchel/materials, no duplicate cells, no missing cells, no clipping. Only the requested pose/view changes. Clean transparent alpha all outside actual character silhouettes.
